reason: AFG underwrites specialty commercial property and casualty insurance (specialty casualty, property and transportation, specialty financial) for businesses. Stewart sells title insurance and escrow and closing services tied to real estate transactions. The two products are different. Customers are different too: AFG sells to commercial policyholders, and Stewart sells to homebuyers, lenders and real estate professionals. Both are regulated insurers that earn premiums and sell through agents, but that shared model is not enough to make them peers.
